sections.title: Snapshot
sections.content: Snapshot time: 2026-11-07 17:30 UTC. Scope: Daily. Date range: 2026-11-07 through 2026-11-07. Ranking basis: daily GitHub Trending star gains, descending; ties retain page order.

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Agent skills and agent-facing applications dominate today’s strongest momentum: a security-audit workflow, multi-agent desktop bot, and social-account finder lead the list. The top 15 gathered repositories span practical agent workflows alongside enduring developer infrastructure and local-first tools.

sections.title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
sections.description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings.
sections.content: A staged security-audit workflow with coverage tracking, independent candidate verification, and machine-readable reports.
sections.why_notable: Its 2,088-star gain led the daily snapshot; the README describes coverage-led hunting and independent verification rather than free-form findings.

sections.title: milind-soni/OpenMausBot
sections.description: Open-source Grok Bot alternative with a virtual machine that bots can use.
sections.content: A local-first desktop chat app for running a roster of agents through existing CLI tools.
sections.why_notable: Its 1,986-star gain makes it one of the strongest movers; its README frames the product as a messaging interface for local, user-controlled agents.
sections.unique_caveat: Ubuntu Wayland host control remains disabled while the README-referenced issue is resolved.

sections.title: sherlock-project/sherlock
sections.description: Hunt down social media accounts by username across social networks.
sections.content: A command-line tool for searching social networks for accounts matching a username.
sections.why_notable: A mature, non-agent project is among the day’s largest gainers, providing a counterpoint to the concentration of agent-related repositories.

sections.title: zed-industries/zed
sections.description: Code at the speed of thought – Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter.
sections.content: A high-performance, multiplayer code editor.
sections.why_notable: Its daily pickup shows that established editor tooling remains a major strand alongside agent projects.

sections.content: A collection of small, composable skills for practical software engineering with coding agents.
sections.why_notable: The README emphasizes editable, composable workflows that can be used across agent products; it had 1,111 stars today.
sections.unique_caveat: Installation and update behavior varies across supported agents.

sections.stars_gained_note: N/A - not available from GitHub; discovered via recent-created repository search and not ranked against Trending star gains
sections.why_notable: GitHub Search identifies it as created on 2026-11-05 and recently pushed; its README describes a research-preview GPU renderer with a render-inspect-revise workflow. It is appended as a fresh-project signal, not compared with Trending daily star gains.
sections.unique_caveat: The README labels it a research preview; its black-hole example is described as a numerical approximation, not an exact relativistic solver.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Reusable agent skills and security workflows are represented by Cloudflare’s audit skill, Matt Pocock’s collection, Google’s product skills, and Anthropic’s skills. Multi-agent desktop use, browser control, agent-ready UI, and context management appear in OpenMausBot, agent-browser, meta/astryx, and billion-context. Established tooling (Zed, Ruff, Tailwind CSS) and infrastructure (Prometheus) remain visible. Recent-created repository search surfaced Vork, a headless GPU renderer for agent-authored 3D/VFX scenes. Language tally for the selected 15: Python 4; Rust 4; TypeScript 4; Go 1; JavaScript 1; Shell 1.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Today’s clearest signal is the move from general-purpose coding agents toward reusable, inspectable workflows and the tools around them. Security auditing, multi-agent desktop use, and portable engineering skills are the strongest daily gainers, while mature developer infrastructure and local-first projects remain part of the mix.

sections.title: Sources and Method
sections.content: Primary source: https://github.com/trending?since=daily, captured 2026-11-07 at 17:30 UTC. Corroboration: GitHub REST repository and default-branch commit endpoints were checked for all listed repositories; GitHub Search API query pushed:2026-11-06..2026-11-07 stars:>100 was used as an additional recency cross-check and not to rank the Trending list. Ranking follows the daily Trending page’s displayed star gains, descending, with ties retaining page order. Total stars and commit SHAs are REST values checked at capture time. Trending is a time-sensitive snapshot, not a final full-day total.
